Trump Welcomes Xi Jinping to US for Trade and Diplomacy Talks

Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Washington for a state visit and was welcomed by U.S. President Donald Trump at Joint Base Andrews. This visit, the first by Xi to the U.S. in 10 years, is focused on trade, artificial intelligence, and Iran, aiming to maintain a diplomatic and economic truce between the two nations. Trump broke protocol by meeting Xi at the airbase rather than the executive residence. The visit includes discussions on potential deals and extends trade talks by two months. During the welcome, two B-1 bomber aircraft flew overhead.
